brand_identity.name: QMRT Nexus
brand_identity.description: A high-fidelity scientific interface for monitoring and manipulating the fabric of reality. It feels like a tool used by a Type II civilization engineer.
brand_identity.aesthetic: Scientific Brutalism meets Cyberpunk HUD. Dense, precise, and dark.
principles: Data over Decoration: Every pixel must convey information or structure.
Immersive Depth: Use layers (z-index), glassmorphism, and borders to create a sense of looking 'into' the simulation.
Reactive Feedback: The interface feels alive. Hover states are instant, data updates pulse.
Safety Colors: Use universal hazard colors (Red/Amber/Cyan) to communicate system stability.

mono.usage: Data values, coordinates, IDs, technical parameters

cards.style: bg-card/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-border/50 rounded-lg overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-sm h-10 px-6
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary/20 text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/30 border border-secondary/50 rounded-sm font-mono uppercase text-sm h-10 px-4

inputs.default: bg-background/50 border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 rounded-sm font-mono text-sm h-10

visualizations.charts: Recharts with custom tooltips, minimal axes, and glowing lines
visualizations.badges: rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider border

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'lucide-react' for icons if not present.
Create a 'Layout' component that wraps the app with a dark background, grid pattern, and navigation.
Use 'Recharts' for all data visualization (density, torsion, etc.).
Implement a 'WorldCard' component that displays key metrics (Death Level, Population, Stability) in a compact grid item.
The 'Create World' flow should feel like initiating a simulation protocol. Use a multi-step form or a dense control panel.
Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT use default blue/slate colors. Use the specific neon accents defined.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast. Use light gray (#A1A1AA) for labels and white (#EDEDED) for values.

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text meets WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text).
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements using 'ring-primary'.
accessibility.labels: All inputs and buttons must have aria-labels or visible labels.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic gradients. Use subtle radial gradients for spotlights.
Avoid 'Inter' for everything. Use 'JetBrains Mono' (or similar) for numbers and data.
Spacing is key. Don't crowd the interface. Use 'gap-6' or 'gap-8' for main layouts.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (simulating system alerts).
